snippet.title: Let's Sing ABBA | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Thank you for the music! let the lights find you and celebrate the unforgettable Magic of ABBA!
Let's Sing ABBA is available now!

After a first successful release in 2022, Let's Sing ABBA is back ! With 32 songs from the iconic disco band and 7 game modes, enter the light and sing your heart out to your all-time favorites. What will be your first song to sing?
